title: MusicDrop v1.3.6 Available
changelog:
• Theme & Skin Studio: 4 layout skins (Rounded Card, Radial Vinyl Ring with center digital time counter, Radial Ring Up Next Drawer, Scenic Mountain Wallpaper) inspired by extracted player styles
• Video Mode & Direct Embedded Player: 3-way toggle (Song | Video | Lyrics) with instant embedded HD playback
• Direct Download Hub: Download Audio (MP3 320kbps) & Download Video (MP4 HD) right from the player utility row
• Pure Gradient Backgrounds: Clean, vivid theme backdrops with removed blown-up cover art blur
• Collapsible Dashboard Header: Sticky icon tabs with scroll-collapse branding header
• Immersive System Bars: Hidden Android navigation bar for distraction-free edge-to-edge experience
